source_note: 函数与序列的上下极限
english_source_note: Limsup and Liminf of Functions and Sequences
callout_id: 函数与序列的上下极限#10
statement_en:
Let $x_n$ be a bounded sequence with limit superior $U$ and limit inferior $L$. Let $f:I\to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous, where $I$ is an open interval containing the closed interval $[L,U]$. Then:
1. If $f$ is nondecreasing on $I$, then $$\limsup_{n\to \infty} f(x_n)=f(U),\qquad \liminf_{n\to \infty} f(x_n)=f(L).$$
2. If $f$ is nonincreasing on $I$, then $$\limsup_{n\to \infty} f(x_n)=f(L),\qquad \liminf_{n\to \infty} f(x_n)=f(U).$$
key_techniques: continuous monotone transformation of subsequential limits
map extrema of cluster points through monotone functions
callout_body:
$x_n$是一个有界序列，假设其上下极限分别为$U,L$。此时考虑一个连续函数$f:I\to \mathbb{R}$，其中$I$是一个包含闭区间$[L,U]$的**开区间**于是：
1. 如果函数$f$在$I$上是单调不减的，那么$$\limsup_{n\to \infty} f(x_n)=f(U),\liminf_{n\to \infty} f(x_n)=f(L)$$
2. 如果函数$f$在$I$上是单调不增的，那么$$\limsup_{n\to \infty} f(x_n)=f(L),\liminf_{n\to \infty} f(x_n)=f(U)$$
